drhp.business: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries makes and markets innovative medicines, branded generics, generics, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and consumer healthcare products for patients and healthcare systems worldwide. Its innovative-medicines business is focused on dermatology, ophthalmology and onco-dermatology, supported by a broad generics pipeline and API portfolio. The company serves 100+ countries with 67% of revenue coming from international operations.

litigation.note: Ongoing US Ranitidine/Zantac Multi-District Litigation over alleged nitrosamine-impurity injuries (generic defendants' dismissal with prejudice on appeal; related state-court and Canadian class actions), a US antitrust matter in which Sun settled West Virginia state-court claims without admission of liability, and other product-liability/antitrust and BPO litigation. Several matters remain pending across US federal, state and Canadian courts.

risks.note: Failure to maintain the highest standards of corporate governance and business ethics could result in regulatory consequences as well as financial and reputational damage.
risks.risk: Corporate governance and business ethics failure

risks.note: As a pharmaceutical manufacturer, lapses in product quality or safety can trigger recalls, regulatory action and reputational harm; the Company reports customer complaints on packaging defects (damaged label/outer packaging, product quality).
risks.risk: Product quality, safety and recall management

risks.note: The Company operates across ~90 countries and must maintain continual regulatory compliance and cGMP standards at all operational locations; non-compliance may adversely affect reputation and long-term business continuity.
Climate Change is flagged as a material topic; both physical and transition risks are evaluated as emerging environmental challenges requiring a proactive response.
Exports account for 72.3% of total turnover, exposing the Company to global market demand, cross-border regulatory and geographic risks across six continents.
Attracting, retaining and nurturing a diverse and skilled workforce is a key area; people are cited as a key driver of success.
risks.risk: Talent attraction, retention and workforce diversity

risks.note: Safety is described as non-negotiable, requiring building not just systems but a safety mindset across all levels of the organization.
